name: Flourish line draw
looks: A single continuous pen line draws itself across the frame in dense, looping calligraphic flourishes, never resolving into legible letters, filling open space with craft and motion between two type beats.
build: One long SVG path with many control points, strokeDashoffset drawn from full length to 0 over 1.5-2.5s as one continuous gesture. Thin monochrome stroke matching the body type's colour.
sound: A very soft pen-on-paper scratch, rising and falling with the line's speed.
prompt: Draw a single continuous pen line in dense looping calligraphic flourishes across the frame, never resolving into legible words, as a connective, textural beat between two type-led moments.
